en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a two-story building with a gabled roof, attached to a single-story structure on the right. The building is surrounded by a low wooden fence, and there are mountains visible in the hazy background. The style of the architecture and the photograph suggests a mid-20th century European setting. There is some barely visible hand-written or printed text on the right side of the image.
